# AnoNote - Private & Anonymous Messenger Web Application

> AnoNote is a zero-knowledge, end-to-end encrypted anonymous messaging and voice/video calling Progressive Web Application (PWA). It provides cryptographically secure communication without requiring phone numbers, emails, or personal identification.

## Core Identity & Value Proposition
- **Brand Name**: AnoNote
- **Primary Color**: AnoNote Blue (#0284c7 / #00a8fc)
- **Application Category**: Secure Communication / Private Messaging PWA
- **Target Audience**: Privacy-conscious individuals, journalists, researchers, and global users seeking private conversations.
- **Privacy Model**: Zero-knowledge architecture. No personal data collected, no phone numbers, no email addresses, no tracking cookies, no advertising telemetry.

## Key Features & Capabilities
1. **Anon ID Protocol**: Every user generates an anonymous cryptographic keypair and unique Anon ID (e.g., `#ANON-XXXX-XXXX`) entirely on the client.
2. **End-to-End Encryption (E2EE)**: Messages and media attachments are encrypted in transit and at rest.
3. **Anonymous Voice & Video Calling**: Real-time peer communication over secure WebRTC / Socket channels with zero identity leakage.
4. **Disappearing Messages**: Configurable ephemeral messaging timers (24 hours, 7 days, 90 days) ensuring total communication hygiene.
5. **Ephemeral Status Stories**: Share anonymous text and image updates that expire automatically.
6. **Progressive Web App (PWA)**: Installable directly from browser on iOS Safari, Android Chromium, Windows, macOS, and Linux with offline app shell caching.
7. **Offline Caching**: Built-in service worker enables offline message browsing and resilient network reconnection.
